portal-bridge.description: Spotify Portal MCP via mcp-remote bridge with CIMD (SEP-991). LIVE VERIFIED 2026-10-19T20:51Z: OAuth consent completed, token minted, MCP initialize + tools/list succeed against the live Portal endpoint. Arg order fixed 2026-10-17: server URL is first positional arg (mcp-remote 0.15.1 contract). --host 127.0.0.1 is REQUIRED (2026-10-19): the CIMD registers redirect_uris=['http://127.0.0.1:47290/oauth/callback'] but mcp-remote defaults to 'localhost' on non-Windows, and the AS rejects the mismatch with HTTP 400 'Invalid redirect_uri ... not registered in client metadata'. See docs/sessions/2026-10-15-portal-xirp-resume/STATE.md §27.

_historical_blockers_for_audit_trail: Cloudflare Worker deployed at auth.kooshapari.com serving application/json at /oauth/client-metadata.json
Portal App Settings -> Allowed client ID patterns includes https://auth.kooshapari.com/*
_deploy_notes.arg_order_fixed: 2026-10-17 — server URL is first positional arg, mcp-remote 0.15.1 contract. Prior order (--transport before URL) caused 'TypeError: Invalid URL ... input: --transport'.
_deploy_notes.redirect_uri_host_fix: 2026-10-19 — added '--host 127.0.0.1'. mcp-remote's default callback host is 'localhost' on non-Windows (chunk-KJCT2FXL.js: let host = process.platform === 'win32' ? '127.0.0.1' : 'localhost'). The CIMD registers 127.0.0.1, so the authorize request failed with HTTP 400 InputError. This was the true blocker behind the 'bridge reached authorize but never completed consent' symptom; the BROWSER=/usr/bin/true in test-portal-bridge-live.sh masked it.
_deploy_notes.live_verified_result: OAuth consent completed in Safari; tokens.json written with access_token, id_token, refresh_token. MCP initialize returned serverInfo {name: backstage, version: 0.2.2}; tools/list returned 34 tools; tools/call auth.who-am-i returned the operator's Backstage User entity.
